outcome_rule.description: WON when annual revenue is at least 20 times the product base price; otherwise LOST.
outcome_rule.limitation: Synthetic financial-capacity proxy, not verified purchase or actual sales evidence.

rules.amount: product base value x company-size multiplier, capped at 1% of annual revenue when available; no floor overrides the cap
rules.engagement: 25% email open + 35% email click + 20% website visit + 20% meeting
rules.fit: 40% company size + 35% product-industry match + 25% employee-count suitability
rules.ground_truth: injected anomaly labels are separate and are not scoring inputs
rules.intent: 50% demo request + 30% form submission + 20% PAGE_VIEW proxy
rules.qualification: top 3000 leads ranked by total_score; ties break by lead_id
rules.staleness: STALE when latest activity is at least 30 days old; CLOSED when an opportunity exists; remaining leads are OPEN
rules.won: WON when annual_revenue >= product_base_price * OUTCOME_REVENUE_MULTIPLE; otherwise LOST; independent of lead-score rank and marketing activity
